# Impeccable Cookie Company

> The perfect cookie, made in Michigan. A Michigan home bakery: I bake chocolate chip and snickerdoodle cookies to order in my home kitchen in Michigan, and I sell within Michigan only. There is no checkout: you send a request, I confirm it with you, and you pay only after that.

## How ordering works

1. Send a request with the order form at https://impeccablecookie.com/#order. Pick your cookies and how many. It is a request, not a purchase, so nothing is charged.
2. I confirm with you. I reach out by your preferred method (email, call or text) to confirm the details. Before you pay, you are welcome to meet me in person or on a video call to ask about ingredients, allergens or anything else.
3. Pay by Venmo. Once your order is confirmed, pay by Venmo to @impeccablecookie. Never before.

Pickup, delivery or shipping, all within Michigan only. Orders are for personal use and gifting; I don't sell for resale or wholesale. Ask me about ingredients and allergens before you order.

Made in a home kitchen that has not been inspected by the Michigan Department of Agriculture and Rural Development.

## Contact
